title: AVL Tree
description: Write a Zig program that implements an AVL tree with rotations for self-balancing.
hints: AVL trees maintain a balance factor (height difference) of -1, 0, or 1
Left rotation: makes the right child the new root
Right rotation: makes the left child the new root
